_comment: Oracle AI Database@Azure Exadata shape catalogue. Single source of truth for the
shape, database_server_type and storage_server_type dropdowns on the Azure page.
Edit this file, or use /regions, to add a shape or a server type — no code
change needed. A bad edit is rejected on save, so the file on disk is never
left in a state that would empty the dropdowns.
label                  Human name shown in the dropdown.
status                 live | planned. Planned shapes are shown greyed out.
storage_server_types   Values offered for storage_server_type. HC = High
server_types_required  Both server types must be set for this shape. The card marks
them required and /api/validate rejects a blank one.
The Azure page offered only X9M and X11M before this catalogue existed, while
AWS and GCP offered X10M as well — the three lists had drifted apart. X10M is
listed here as planned rather than live: add it as live once confirmed for
